conviction_note: The reaction depends on whether the company raises its full-year forecast. Its last three guidance-changing prints moved +3.4%, +20.4% and +14.9%; its last three prints with a held forecast moved -2.1%, -0.05% and -2.2%. The full-year plan implies a flat second half after a +47.6% Q1 operating profit. So a raise is more likely than not (about 60-65%), but the stock ran up 8.2% in five days, margin longs are crowded (15.7x) and the sector's beat-and-hold names were sold this week. That gives p_up 58 on an abs move of 5.5 (+0.88 scaled), against a findings sum of +1.7. The findings sum each fact on its own size; the scaled number carries the hold branch.

For the guidance line: IFIS consensus FY ordinary 24,500m / OP 24,000m as of 2026-07-28, against the company's 23,500m / 24,000m (https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/1946_20260729_act_20260729_153014_6). findings.finding: The FY plan (OP 24,000m) implies H2 OP of about 12,700-13,000m, flat on last year's H2 12,855m (4,379+8,476). Yet Q1 OP rose 47.6% to 5,062m on a gross margin of 19.9% vs 15.8%, and standalone orders rose 31.5% (74,858m vs 56,920m). The company revised its FY forecast at the H1 print in each of the last two years (24/10/29 and 25/10/28; last year ordinary 17,000->20,000m, +18%). A raise would also lift the dividend under the stated ~40% payout policy (76 JPY at a 39.5% payout).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance-changing prints: H1 2024-10-29 (FY revised) +3.41% next day; H1 2025-10-28 (FY ordinary +18%, dividend policy change) +20.39%; FY 2026-04-28 (new guide plus MTP target raised 180->260 億円) +6.99% then +14.85%. Held-forecast prints: Q3 2026-02-02 -2.17%, Q1 2026-07-29 -0.05%, Q1 2025-07-29 -2.14% (Yahoo daily bars).

findings.why_not_priced: kabutan's 2026-10-25 list of 32 likely upward revisers this week (https://kabutan.jp/news/marketnews/?b=n202610250063) leaves Toenec out: its screen uses Q1 progress against the FULL-year plan (20.8%), which hides the H1 and H2 arithmetic. IFIS consensus (24,500m) sits only 4% above plan and was last dated 2026-07-28. If a 10%+ raise were priced, the stock would not trade at 11.3x PER, below where it sat after the April guide (2,444 close on 2026-04-30 against 2,180 now). The 5-day +8.2% does price part of it, and that is why this finding is held at +2.0 against a +3 to +20 history.
findings.independence: Peer read-through from different issuers on 2026-10-28. Yurtec (Tohoku Electric group) raised FY ordinary 19%, raised its dividend by 6 JPY and announced a 2.47% buyback, with Q2 OP margin up from 6.0% to 8.1% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1934&b=k202610280010). Hokuriku Denko's Q2 OP margin rose from 6.0% to 12.1% (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=1930&b=k202610280012). Same driver as Toenec's Q1 ('工事採算性の向上'), so it is corroborating evidence, not a second Toenec fact.

findings.finding: H1 will land above the company's own H1 plan. Q1 ordinary profit of 4,880m is 51.4% of the 9,500m H1 plan against a 5-year average of 46.7%, and last year's 38.9% Q1 progress still ended 15.8% above plan. A Q2 equal to last year's 5,307m gives H1 ~10,190m (+7%); a Q2 margin like Q1's gives ~10,800m (+14%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2026-02-02 was a large beat against a held FY plan (FY actual later 22,639m vs 20,000m plan) and moved -2.17%. Q1 2026-07-29 was on kabutan's surprise list and moved -0.05%. On this line the stock does not pay for the quarter alone.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Anyone can compute the progress rate from the Q1 短信, so it is filed small. What remains unpriced is the size of the Q2 margin, which no monthly series shows for this company.
findings.independence: Hokuriku Denko's H1 beat 22億 plan at 32.9億 with FY held, and the stock moved -0.8% on 10-28 and -2.1% on 10-29 (Yahoo 1930.T), so a beat alone does not lift the sector. Shares the Q1 短信 with finding 1 (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/19460/140120260728501161.pdf).

findings.finding: Positioning into the print: a Toenec-specific +8.2% 5-day run-in (peers +1-3%) with 信用倍率 15.7x, in a week when the sector's good news got little follow-through. Hokuriku Denko's beat-and-hold fell; Yurtec's raise, dividend increase and buyback made +3.2% intraday, then flat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the +20.4% H1 2025 jump the stock gave back -3.4% and -2.1% over the next two sessions. The Q1 2026 print came after a -4.2%/-3.7% slide and moved flat.
findings.why_not_priced: The baseline lean (-0.61) already carries the margin overhang. What it does not carry is the fresh 5-day run-in on peer news and the peers' muted reactions on 10-28 and 10-29, which show how much a raise has to clear.

baseline_tension: The findings lean positive against a baseline lean of -0.61 (margin overhang) and a +8.2% 5-day run-in that has already priced part of the expected raise. The strongest negative the release could carry is a held FY plan after a beat, which Hokuriku Denko got sold for on 10-28. That branch is why p_up is only 58 and the scaled number (+0.88) sits below the findings sum (+1.7).
lessons_applied: Open question 4 (one case where a +4.4% five-day run-in sized as -1.5 of positioning was followed by +8.15%): finding 3, the run-in positioning negative, cut from -1.0 to -0.7. The cut is because the only precedent cut against it, and because it overlaps the baseline's own margin_overhang lean.

Rule 1 (a finding on a series the market already has): it is written for negatives, but the same logic keeps finding 2 (the visible Q1 progress rate) small. It was already +0.4 in the draft and is left there.
Rule 2 (negatives outnumbering positives): not triggered, since the net is positive. The strongest negative branch, a held FY plan, is written into baseline_tension.
